title.zh: 谷歌财报电话会：Gemini月活用户达10亿，但预计明年资本开支将大幅增加
title.en: 谷歌财报电话会：Gemini月活用户达10亿，但预计明年资本开支将大幅增加

current_state.zh: Alphabet reported Q3 2026 revenue of $127.6B (+25%) with Google Cloud up 103% to $30.7B, disclosed Gemini app reached 1B monthly users and model APIs serve ~32B tokens/minute, unveiled the Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model and Genie 4 progress, while guiding to sharply higher capex next year and posting negative free cash flow — sending shares down 9-10% after hours.
